in_marathi.name: Jasmeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gentle, Merciful, Gracious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jasmeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jasmeet is a beautiful and elegant name derived from Sanskrit. It is a combination of two words, 'Jas' meaning gentle, merciful, and 'Meet' meaning gracious, kind, and lovely. This name evokes images of softness, compassion, and kindness. The name Jasmeet is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and spirituality, symbolizing the divine qualities of compassion and grace.
